subject: moving on
author: Dodger455
body:
I have favorite games from years, and years ago, and it is fun to pull them out, and play them from time to time, but sometimes you have to except that the game you love, and the new version of it just are not the same.

The sequel, (or not), doesn't always meet the expectations of the player.

It sucks, but we must trudge onward into the unknown future of our favorite games.

Late
